decision: Approved publication subset after exact exclusions; retained acceptance evidence is byte-identical.

false_positive_dispositions.disposition: Actual receipt/helper identity keys excluded; retained broad-pattern hits are existing test function names and acceptance artifact filenames.
Retained hits are Python pytest decorators inside source-context snippets; compressed-container accidental matches occur only inside an excluded duplicate checkpoint.
26 occurrences identify generic executor home paths, not a personal account.
65 unique raw URL values classified. Helper-internal endpoints excluded; remaining values are test literals, standard XML/PDF namespaces, public documentation or Debian public support metadata.
Loopback/stub fixtures, PID/clock diagnostics and OCR false positives; no sensitive imagery found.

methods: Read every member of five original evidence archives; recursively inspect nested ZIP/DOCX parts; scan bytes for credential/private-key, endpoint, email, home path and transfer-identity indicators.
Resolve unclassified URLs against original test constants and standard document/distribution metadata.
Copy valid SQLite databases and matching WAL to disposable scratch; query mode=ro/query_only; inspect schema and text/blob values without changing originals.
OCR/text extraction plus contact-sheet visual inspection of every unique image and PDF; duplicate DOCX images verified by content hash.
Repackage only byte-identical permitted members; verify ZIP CRC and every decompressed member SHA256; verify original archive SHA256 unchanged.
limits: Pattern and OCR review reduce accidental disclosure risk but do not claim a mathematical proof of absence.
Some database-named test fixtures intentionally contain non-SQLite bytes; their raw bytes were reviewed and preserved.
No acceptance conclusions, failure records, hardware/platform limitations or product files changed.

package_verification.scope: All acceptance, test, UI, database, sidecar, failure-history and report evidence preserved. Only helper/upload internals, rebuildable runtime caches and redundant stage checkpoints omitted. Eight cache-behavior fixture indexes retained. Public package does not include delivery index/receipts or original archive bundles.
